map.HDR/全景包围曝光按 EV 范围与步长算张数。: HDR/panorama bracketing computes shot count by EV range and step.

map.范围 ±3EV、步长 1EV：张数 = ceil(6/1)×2+1 = 13 张: Range +/-3EV, step 1EV: count = ceil(6/1)x2+1 = 13 shots, lowest EV = mid-3, highest = mid+3, covering 6 stops of light.
map.范围 ±2EV、步长 2EV：张数 = ceil(4/2)×2+1 = 5 张，: Range +/-2EV, step 2EV: count = ceil(4/2)x2+1 = 5 shots, half the count but coarser light transition, good for even lighting.
map.以中值为中心向两端各 N 步共 2N 张，加中值 1 张得 2N+1；步长越小张: Centered on the median, N steps each end totals 2N shots, plus the median 1 gives 2N+1; smaller step means more shots and smoother blending.
map.反差大用 1EV 细过渡，反差小用 2–3EV 省张；HDR 一般 ±2~3EV: High contrast uses 1EV fine transition, low contrast uses 2-3EV to save shots; HDR usually +/-2~3EV with 1EV step is enough.
